result.instructions: Tools for Talenox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on leave next week, and who approves each request?"; "Show the pending leave applications for October."; "How many days of annual leave does Alex Tan have left?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Talenox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run talenox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run talenox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run talenox_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. talenox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: talenox_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the company's employees as a short summary (id, employee_id, names, email, hired/resign dates, current job). Talenox returns every employee in one reply, so use search to narrow and limit/offset to page here. Use talenox_get_employee for the full record. Sensitive fields (national id, passport, bank account) are never included.

search.description: Words that must all appear in the name, employee id, nickname or email (case-insensitive).

status.description: active = no resign date or one in the future; resigned = a resign date in the past. Default all.

offset.description: Employees to skip (default 0); use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: talenox_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee's full record: personal details, jobs, cost centres, custom fields. National id, passport, bank account and health fields are left out unless include_sensitive is true.

id.description: The employee's Talenox id (the numeric `id` from talenox_list_employees).

include_sensitive.description: Include national id (ssn), passport, bank account, religion/race and vaccination fields. Default false.

tools.name: talenox_get_job
tools.title: Get a job record
tools.description: Get one job record of an employee (title, department, start/end date, pay amount and rate, currency). Job ids are in the employee's `jobs` list.

id.description: The job id (from an employee's jobs list).

tools.name: talenox_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the company's branches with their head and employee ids.

tools.name: talenox_get_branch
tools.title: Get a branch
tools.description: Get one branch (name, address, head, employee ids).

tools.name: talenox_list_cost_centres
tools.title: List cost centres
tools.description: List the company's cost centres with their employee ids.

tools.name: talenox_list_roles
tools.title: List employee roles
tools.description: List the company's employee roles (access roles).

tools.name: talenox_get_role
tools.title: Get an employee role
tools.description: Get one employee role.

tools.name: talenox_get_company_settings
tools.title: Get company settings
tools.description: Get the company's API-related settings (for example whether an employee may belong to several cost centres).

tools.name: talenox_list_working_days
tools.title: List working-day schedules
tools.description: List the working-day schedules (weekly pattern Sunday to Saturday: full_day, first_half, second_half, not_working) and who is on each.

tools.name: talenox_get_working_day
tools.title: Get a working-day schedule
tools.description: Get one working-day schedule.

tools.name: talenox_list_holiday_policies
tools.title: List holiday policies
tools.description: List the company's public-holiday policies (country, state, default flag). Paged: pass next_last_seen_id as last_seen_id.

last_seen_id.description: Pagination: return results after this id (next_last_seen_id of the previous reply).

tools.name: talenox_get_holiday_policy
tools.title: Get a holiday policy
tools.description: Get one holiday policy with its calendar events between two dates.

tools.name: talenox_list_company_holidays
tools.title: List company holidays
tools.description: List the company's holidays (from its default holiday policy) for a year.

year.description: Calendar year (default: the current year at Talenox).

tools.name: talenox_list_leave_applications
tools.title: List leave applications
tools.description: List leave applications that overlap a date range, optionally by status, employee, approver or leave type. Paged: pass next_last_seen_id as last_seen_id. Uses Talenox's leave API (beta).

overlap_from.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

overlap_to.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

category.description: type = leave type, oil = off in lieu.

category_id.description: Leave type id (category type) or off in lieu id (category oil).

last_seen_id.description: Pagination: return results after this id (next_last_seen_id of the previous reply).

tools.name: talenox_get_leave_application
tools.title: Get a leave application
tools.description: Get one leave application (employee, dates, half-day markers, amount, status, approvers, attachments).

tools.name: talenox_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: List the leave types of the company, or those an employee may apply for (employee_id). Paged: pass next_last_seen_id as last_seen_id.

employee_id.description: Only the leave types open to this employee.

last_seen_id.description: Pagination: return results after this id (next_last_seen_id of the previous reply).

tools.name: talenox_get_leave_type
tools.title: Get a leave type
tools.description: Get one leave type (name, half-day allowed, quantity type, policy dates).

tools.name: talenox_get_leave_balance
tools.title: Get leave balances
tools.description: Get an employee's leave balance on a date, for every leave type or for one (leave_type_id). A type that does not apply to the employee comes back with an error text instead of a balance.

query_date.description: The date to compute the balance for, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: talenox_get_leave_entitlement_period
tools.title: Get leave entitlement periods
tools.description: Get the entitlement periods (start and end dates) of one leave type for an employee around a date.

tools.name: talenox_list_off_in_lieus
tools.title: List off in lieu types
tools.description: List the off-in-lieu types of the company, or of one employee. Paged: pass next_last_seen_id as last_seen_id.

employee_id.description: Only this employee's off in lieus.

last_seen_id.description: Pagination: return results after this id (next_last_seen_id of the previous reply).

tools.name: talenox_get_off_in_lieu_balance
tools.title: Get off in lieu balances
tools.description: Get an employee's off-in-lieu balance on a date, for every off in lieu or for one (off_in_lieu_id).

query_date.description: The date to compute the balance for, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: talenox_list_payroll_payments
tools.title: List payroll payments
tools.description: List the payroll payment runs of a month (period, pay group, status Draft or Processed, bank file state).

month.description: Month name in English, e.g. September.

created_by_webhook.description: Only payments created by a webhook.

tools.name: talenox_get_payroll_payment
tools.title: Get a payroll payment
tools.description: Get one payroll payment run (period, status, bank file and cheque export state).

tools.name: talenox_list_custom_pay_items
tools.title: List custom pay items
tools.description: List the company's pay item definitions (name, category such as Adhoc or Recurring, taxable, gross/net setting).

tools.name: talenox_get_payslips_data
tools.title: Get payslip data
tools.description: Get the payslip figures (gross, net, deductions, year-to-date) of a month as data, for all employees or the listed ones. Read only: nothing is created, processed or published. Contains salary data.

month.description: Month name in English, e.g. September.

items.description: An employee's Talenox employee_id or id.

tools.name: talenox_approve_leave_application
tools.title: Approve a leave application
tools.description: WRITE: approve a leave application as the token's user. The employee's balance and payroll are affected and Talenox may notify them. Read the application first (talenox_get_leave_application) and confirm with the user.

tools.name: talenox_reject_leave_application
tools.title: Reject a leave application
tools.description: WRITE: reject a leave application as the token's user. Talenox may notify the employee. Read the application first (talenox_get_leave_application) and confirm with the user.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Talenox
prompts.description: What you can do with Talenox here, with example requests to try.
